2607.17762.title: Autonomous Discovery of Wireless Communications Algorithms
2607.17762.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is an emerging algorithm-discovery paradigm that has already produced novel results in several scientific fields. Yet its application to wireless communications remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce The AI Telco Engineer (AITE), a framework to autonomously design algorithms for complex communication problems, while navigating performance-complexity tradeoffs. We showcase AITE on two challenging physical-layer problems: designing an equalizer for an orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) system, and constructing a receiver algorithm for an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) system using a custom constellation and operating without pilots. For the first task, AITE develops algorithms that outperform the best-known solutions while reducing computational latency by a factor of 3.6 compared to the strongest baseline. For the second task, it discovers the first explicit, explainable algorithms that achieve performance parity with state-of-the-art neural receivers. These results demonstrate the strong potential of LLM-driven evolutionary search for the autonomous discovery of next-generation wireless communications algorithms.
2607.17762.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的進化搜尋是一種新興的演算法發現範式，已經在幾個科學領域產生了新穎的結果。<lb/>然而，它在無線通信中的應用仍然大多未被探索。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了AI電信工程師（AITE），這是一個自動設計複雜通信問題演算法的框架，同時在性能與複雜性之間進行權衡。<lb/>我們在兩個具有挑戰性的物理層問題上展示AITE：為正交時間頻率空間（OTFS）系統設計一個均衡器，以及為正交頻分多工（OFDM）系統構建一個接收器演算法，使用自定義星座並在沒有導頻的情況下運行。<lb/>在第一個任務中，AITE開發的演算法超越了已知的最佳解，並將計算延遲相比於最強基線減少了3.6倍。<lb/>在第二個任務中，它發現了第一個明確且可解釋的演算法，達到了與最先進的神經接收器相當的性能。<lb/>這些結果展示了LLM驅動的進化搜尋在自動發現下一代無線通信演算法方面的強大潛力。
